Versatile 0.7mm medium point is ideal for a variety of everyday writing activities
Cute mechanical pencils for girls, boys and adults, featuring colorful barrels with eye-catching sparkles

description: Make writing fun and easy with BIC Xtra-Sparkly Mechanical Pencils With Erasers. These 0.7mm mechanical pencils have a medium point that’s ideal for a variety of everyday writing activities. Featuring colorful barrels with eye-catching sparkles, BIC Xtra-Sparkly are trendy, cute mechanical pencils for girls, boys and adults. The selling mechanical pencil in the United States, BIC offers dependable performance and value. They’re the perfect mechanical pencils for school supplies and come equipped with three pieces of lead that’s compatible with most standardized tests. The high-quality lead doesn’t smudge and erases cleanly, so your work looks neat and professional. BIC Xtra-Sparkle mechanical number two pencils never need sharpening; to advance the lead, simply click the built-in eraser. The shimmery design adds a pop of color to your office supplies, and the clear clip easily attaches to pockets, notebooks and more. With this 24-count pack of mechanical pencils, you can write with style all year long. Choose BIC Xtra-Sparkly Number 2 Mechanical Pencils With Erasers for a high-quality, safe and affordable product you can trust.
